title: channel_order / channel_order_update directive payload, v1
description: Payload of the cloud-to-till directives `channel_order` and `channel_order_update` (reference/contracts/sales-channel-v1.md section 5.1). The directive envelope (StoreDirective) has exactly two required fields, `type` and `payload`, plus the envelope `id` which is the directive's identity (the payload has no id of its own); this schema is the `payload`. Money is an integer in minor units (7399, never 7399.0), tax in basis points, time RFC 3339 UTC with a `Z` suffix. No customer name, address, email or phone: contact details are only ever fetched live (channel.contact.ask). `channel_order_update` carries the full current order; the till applies a payload only when its `revision` is higher than the last applied one for (connection_id, external_order_id). Validators MUST enable format checking (`uuid`, `date-time`); the patterns make the shape hold even where they do not. `qty` is the quantity as ordered plus units added by later edits and is never lowered; removal, cancellation and refund are expressed only through refunded_quantity / restocked_quantity. Cross-field rules (total formula, refunded_quantity <= qty, restocked_quantity <= refunded_quantity, discount_line_minor <= qty*unit_price_minor, refund_total_minor <= total_minor) cannot be expressed in JSON Schema and are enforced by the cloud (section 5.1 'Cloud-enforced checks').

schema_version.description: Payload schema version. A till that does not advertise support for it is never sent this directive (section 5.1).

external_version.description: Informational only (display, support). Never compared for ordering.

revision.description: Issued by the cloud per (connection_id, external_order_id), strictly increasing by 1 per stored change. The only ordering key.

order_number.description: Shop-facing number as the shop knows it, e.g. "#1001".

placed_at.description: UTC with a `Z` suffix only; offsets are rejected.

status.description: ADR-0169 section 9 machine. The cloud's canonical status (the plugin's is only channel-reported, section 2); transitions in section 5.1.

payment_state.description: The channel's payment state, informational; never drives `status`.

external_id.description: The channel's line id; stable across revisions (contract section 2).

cloud_item_id.description: Absent when the line could not be linked to a UT item; never an empty string.

cloud_variant_id.description: Absent when the line is not linked to a variant; never an empty string.

sku.description: Empty string for a line that is not linked to a SKU.

name.description: Product title as sold, for display of unlinked lines. At most 256, the bound of the channel host's personal-data gate, which lets this one free-text key through (sales-channel-v1.md section 9.3).

qty.description: Quantity as ordered plus units added by later order edits. Lines never disappear and qty is never lowered: a removed, cancelled or refunded unit is expressed only through refunded_quantity (and restocked_quantity). Reporting a lowered qty together with a restocked refund double-counts stock and is non-conformant (section 5.1).

tax_included.description: True when unit_price_minor already contains the tax.

discount_line_minor.description: Total discount for the whole line (all units), not per unit.

refunded_quantity.description: Cumulative units refunded or cancelled so far, 0 to qty (cloud-enforced).

restocked_quantity.description: Running total of refunded units that went back into stock, 0 to refunded_quantity (cloud-enforced). Stock moves by the difference from the last applied revision.

order_discount_minor.description: Discounts not attributed to a line (order-level codes, shipping discounts).

tax_added_minor.description: Tax the channel added on top of tax-exclusive lines and shipping; 0 when everything is tax-inclusive.

refund_total_minor.description: Cumulative amount refunded so far, at most total_minor.

total_minor.description: sum(qty * unit_price_minor - discount_line_minor) + shipping_minor - order_discount_minor + tax_added_minor.
